## Highlights This patch release fixes two CLI regressions introduced in 2.16.0. ### Bug fixes **CLI** * Fixed-length tuple positionals such as `CliPositionalArg[tuple[int, int]]` and `NamedTuple`s are single-valued again ([#1069](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/1069)). Since 2.16.0 they were treated as variadic, so a CLI either refused to start with a `SettingsError` or put the wrong argument into the tuple. Variable-length tuples (`tuple[int, ...]` and bare `Tuple`) are still variadic. * A field typed as an alias of a list of dicts, e.g. `type ListOfDict = list[dict[str, int]]`, accepts a JSON list again ([#1049](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/1049)). Since 2.16.0, `--xx '[{"a":1},{"b":2}]'` was merged into the single dict `{"a": 1, "b": 2}` and failed validation.
All changes (including dependency bumps and internal maintenance) ## What's Changed * Harden CI by @Viicos in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/1044 * Keep list of dicts CLI values as lists by @hramezani in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/1049 * Keep fixed-length tuple CLI positionals single-valued by @hramezani in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/1069 * Prepare release 2.16.1 by @hramezani in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/1087 * build(deps): bump the python-packages group with 3 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/1056 **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/compare/v2.16.0...v2.16.1

## Highlights ### Breaking changes and behavior changes * **Python 3.10 is no longer supported** ([#1003](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/1003)). pydantic-settings now requires Python 3.11+, since 3.10 reaches end of life this month. The `tomli` fallback is gone in favor of stdlib `tomllib`; the `toml` extra is kept as an empty extra so `pip install pydantic-settings[toml]` keeps working. * **`python-dotenv>=1.2.2` is now required** ([#971](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/971)) to pick up the fix for CVE-2026-28684. * **Aliases are ignored in every source when `validate_by_alias=False`** ([#1033](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/1033)). Env vars, secrets, CLI flags and defaults now use only field names, matching pydantic. An env var named after the alias is now ignored instead of raising `extra_forbidden`, and the CLI exposes `--apple` rather than `--pomo`. * **`validation_alias` takes precedence over `alias`** ([#1038](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/1038)). When the two differ, values from JSON/YAML/TOML files and the CLI were silently ignored; they now load. CLI help lists the `validation_alias` flag first, and `CliApp.serialize` emits it. * **CLI case-insensitivity only lowercases registered options** ([#1036](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/1036)). With `case_sensitive=False`, args after `--` and those captured by `CliUnknownArgs` keep their case (`-Xmx4G` no longer becomes `-xmx4g`). Unrecognized options are now reported as typed (`--NOPE` instead of `--nope`). * **JSON and YAML config files are read as UTF-8 by default** ([#955](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/955)) instead of the locale encoding, completing the secrets-file fix from 2.15.0. `json_file_encoding`/`yaml_file_encoding` still override it. * **Discriminated union defaults are partially updated again** ([#997](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/997)). This reverts the 2.15.0 regression with `nested_model_default_partial_update=True`: the default is only dropped when the incoming value selects a *different* union member. ### New features * **Python 3.15 and pydantic 2.14 support** ([#1026](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/1026), [#1029](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/1029), [#1022](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/1022)). pydantic 2.14 broke `CliApp.run` and `validate_by_alias=False` handling; both are fixed. * **Cached settings instances** via `Settings.settings_cached()` and `Settings.settings_clear_cache()` ([#952](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/952)). These give you a process-local singleton per settings class without hand-rolling `lru_cache` wrappers. Calling the class directly still builds a fresh instance. * **AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store source** — `AWSSystemsManagerSettingsSource` ([#941](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/941)). It recursively reads every parameter under an `ssm_path`, with `/` mapping onto nested models. Install it with the new `aws-systems-manager` extra. * **`env_file_depth`** ([#940](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/940)) lets a relative `env_file` be found in parent directories, mirroring `pyproject_toml_depth`. This is useful when scripts run from a subdirectory of a monorepo. It defaults to `0`, which keeps the current behavior. * **`CliVariadicArg` for named variadic options** ([#949](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/949), [#958](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/958)). It accepts `--param a b c` in addition to repeated `--param a --param b`. Required fields need at least one value. ### Bug fixes **CLI** * `CliApp.serialize` output now round-trips through `CliApp.run` for enums, tuples, dates and `Decimal`s ([#988](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/988)), explicit `None` values ([#981](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/981)), empty containers ([#1008](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/1008)), `CliVariadicArg` values ([#976](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/976)) and populated `CliUnknownArgs` fields, which previously raised `IndexError` ([#992](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/992)). * Empty JSON arrays (`--items []`) now give an empty list instead of `['']` ([#994](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/994)). * Tuples, `frozenset`, `MutableSequence` and other collection subtypes are now treated as repeatable/variadic options ([#972](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/972)), and so are named collection type aliases such as `TypeAliasType('Addrs', list[IPvAnyAddress])` ([#1032](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/1032)). * `cli_exit_on_error=False` is now honored in `CliSubCommand` parsers, which raise `SettingsError` instead of exiting ([#977](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/977)). * `CliSubCommand` aliases keep their case with `case_sensitive=False` ([#989](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/989)). * Each `CliUnknownArgs` field now receives only its own subcommand's leftover args ([#1004](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/1004)). * `CliApp.format_help` no longer crashes when `cli_prefix` is set in `model_config` ([#945](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/945)). **Type aliases and parsing** * Named union type aliases (`TypeAliasType('V', list[int] | str)`) now decode like their inline equivalents in env and dotenv sources, including under `Optional`, `Annotated` and custom validation aliases ([#1006](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/1006), [#1030](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/1030), [#1041](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/1041)). * Resolving a named `Annotated` type alias no longer mutates shared `FieldInfo` metadata, which made validators run twice on subclasses or after `model_rebuild()` ([#979](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/979)). * A bare single-segment `AliasPath('SOME_KEY')` no longer tries to JSON-decode plain string values ([#980](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/980)). * `collections.abc.Set`/`MutableSet`/`typing.AbstractSet` fields now JSON-decode env values ([#973](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/973)). * A bare `typing.Dict` field with `env_nested_delimiter` no longer raises `IndexError`, which was a regression in 2.13.0 ([#1009](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/1009)). * Case-insensitive matching now works for nested pydantic dataclasses ([#1010](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/1010)). **Dotenv, secrets and config files** * With `extra='allow'`, a non-lowercase `env_prefix` is now stripped from dotenv extras ([#959](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/959), [#968](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/968)). * `secrets_case_sensitive=True` is now honored on Windows ([#1001](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/1001)). * An empty JSON config file is treated as an empty mapping instead of crashing ([#947](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/947)), matching YAML and TOML. * TOML table headers: `~` paths are now expanded when checking that the file exists ([#1034](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/1034)), and an explicit `toml_table_header=()` now overrides the model config to read the file root ([#1027](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/1027)). **Cloud sources** * Azure Key Vault and GCP Secret Manager now honor `env_parse_none_str` ([#1019](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/1019), [#1040](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/1040)). * Azure Key Vault: `dash_to_underscore=True` now works for nested model fields ([#1025](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/1025)). * `NestedSecretsSettingsSource` now validates its specific constructor arguments ([#975](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/975)). * `DotenvFiltering` is exported from `pydantic_settings.sources.types` ([#944](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/944)). ### Documentation * Document that runtime validation arguments (`strict`, `extra`, `context`) passed to `model_validate()` are not applied to `BaseSettings`, and give a workaround ([#1017](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/1017)). * Explain why `extra='forbid'` doesn't reject misspelled top-level env vars ([#986](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/986)). * Clarify alias plus nested model env lookup with `populate_by_name` ([#933](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/933)), and add a nested model example for `env_prefix_target` ([#953](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/953)). * Fix assorted typos ([#942](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/942), [#964](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/964)).

## Highlights ### Behavior changes * **`case_sensitive` now applies to init kwargs and config-file sources** ([#900](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/900)). `InitSettingsSource` and the JSON/TOML/YAML config sources previously ignored `case_sensitive`. Since it defaults to `False`, **case-insensitive matching is now the default** for these sources — e.g. `Settings(TeSt=...)` now populates a `test` field where it previously did not. Nested keys are still matched case-sensitively. * **Fields with unresolved forward references now emit a warning** ([#901](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/901)). Settings sources can silently fail to resolve such fields; they now raise `IncompleteFieldDefinitionWarning` telling you to call `model_rebuild()`. If you have `filterwarnings = error` configured, this may surface as a new failure. * **Non-JSON env values for strict fields now raise `ValidationError`** ([#926](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/926)) instead of a less specific error. ### New features * **Show environment variable names in CLI help** via `cli_show_env_vars=True` ([#860](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/860)), so generated `--help` output doubles as configuration documentation. * **`PYDANTIC_SETTINGS_DEBUG` for debugging settings resolution** ([#906](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/906), [#913](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/913)). Windows upper-cases `os.environ` keys, so fields raised `Field required` instead of picking up their values. * Read secret files as UTF-8 instead of the platform locale encoding ([#917](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/917)). On Windows code pages such as cp1252 this silently corrupted non-ASCII secrets. * Fix `AliasPath` on nested model fields not JSON-decoding env values ([#898](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/898)). * Fix case-insensitive matching for **optional** nested models ([#905](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/905)). * Fix dotenv extras being wrongly claimed by a complex field sharing a name prefix ([#912](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/912)) — e.g. `dbx_token` being swallowed by a `db: dict` field. * Fix `nested_model_default_partial_update=True` corrupting discriminated unions ([#876](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/876)). * Fix `Secret` subclasses crashing when loaded from the environment ([#920](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/920)). * Fix enum names not parsing through nested annotations such as `Optional[Annotated[MyEnum, ...]]` with `env_parse_enums=True` ([#910](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/910)). * An empty `yaml_config_section` now falls back to defaults instead of raising `AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'keys'` ([#914](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/914)). * `NestedSecretsSettingsSource` no longer follows symlinks pointing outside `secrets_dir` ([#889](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/889)). * GCP: skip the `list_secrets` call when `case_sensitive=True` ([#862](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/862)), ## What's Changed

This is a security patch release.

* Prevent `NestedSecretsSettingsSource` from following symlinks outside `secrets_dir` by @hramezani in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/889
* Prepare release 2.14.2 by @hramezani in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/890

### Security

Fixes [GHSA-4xgf-cpjx-pc3j](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/security/advisories/GHSA-4xgf-cpjx-pc3j): `NestedSecretsSettingsSource` with `secrets_nested_subdir=True` could follow a symbolic link inside `secrets_dir` pointing outside it, reading out-of-tree files into settings values and bypassing the `secrets_dir_max_size` cap. Affected versions: `>= 2.12.0, < 2.14.2`.
